evidence.name: Screen Editor: Sticky Container
evidence.userNeed: Know what the Sticky Container section controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Sticky Container section
sections.description: The Sticky Container pins one call-to-action button to the bottom of the screen so it stays visible while the visitor scrolls long content. Turn it on for screens where the next-step or buy button would otherwise scroll out of view — long sales copy, feature lists, the paywall — because keeping the button always tappable is one of the simplest ways to lift click-through on paid traffic. Leave it off on short screens that fit without scrolling, where it just adds clutter.
